name: Beast
note: WP-CR: painted AI Studio cards (engine/rbx/card.js, frames in engine/rbx/cards/beast/): black robotic school monster, spikes, long clawed arms past the knees, box head with jagged teeth and glowing red slit eyes (an additive eyes card on top). 4.5 D tall (cardHeight overrides). Frames: front idle / step / reach / roar, side walk x4 + reach + roar, back idle + step. The pose picks the frame (view from the camera, walk step, reach, scream face = roar).
v1: 2.5x tall black spiky robotic monster, long thin black arms, rectangular head with glowing red eyes + jagged teeth
